PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

2. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables

----
